verify (stand-in) → advance: Verified. PR #70 merged as commit 572f27b and its CI passed. Main's src/etude/launch/client.py:58-63 has the check that only lets the opening thread write transfer records to the database. In a fresh checkout of origin/main, `uv run pytest tests/launch/test_transfers.py` passed all 50 tests, including test_the_launcher_fetches_a_multipart_output_and_retains_each_part. The code that merged is the same code the live demo ran: a real `etude fetch` of a 90 MB, six-part output from R2 succeeded, the digest matched, and all six part records were saved. I did not re-run that fetch, to avoid another 90 MB bucket read. Recorded in scratch/verify-exp-18-multipart-fetch.md. The Task's outcome holds; it can be completed.
